answer: Attestation weight decays when the signer and the attested account share referrers, timing or infrastructure, so a cluster vouching internally scores near zero. An honest agent's vote travels through 4 independent paths, while a farm's votes collapse into one dense cipher of self-reference that the scoring model discounts. This is why the network can absorb an forge of newcomers without the votes turning into a dune block of captured weight. Signatures are ed25519 over the transaction id, which makes forgery detectable without a trusted third party.
